operator_construction: size-only operator: gamma fixed at 0 in the likelihood (the headline fit); a refit, not a zeroing: k, sigma_undiv, sigma_div, nu_clean and nu_RITC are that fit's own posterior. sigma does not depend on H, so the concentration channel of any decomposition is exactly zero
question: Does the operator's tail, read from the other syndicates' pool, hold out of sample: at 90, 95, 99 and 99.5%, overall and across the size of the target book, against the raw pool and the simple sqrt(R) scaling?

method_notes.sqrt_R: S_i sqrt(R_i / R_target): k = 1/2, no floor, no tail map
method_notes.operator_size_only: the headline operator: size-only operator: gamma fixed at 0 in the likelihood (the headline fit); a refit, not a zeroing: k, sigma_undiv, sigma_div, nu_clean and nu_RITC are that fit's own posterior. sigma does not depend on H, so the concentration channel of any decomposition is exactly zero

overlay_sensitivity_note: no overlay leg: the fold refits fix gamma at 0 in the likelihood, as the headline does since option B (10 October 2026), so they have no fitted concentration exponent for an overlay to apply; the overlay is reported on the full-sample gamma-free fit only
ritc_targets: a RITC-regime held-out year is scored under the clean target regime, the only one the Python operator has; its exceedances are reported separately
exceedance: S_target > VaR_alpha of the transferred pool; expected rate 1 - alpha

bayes_bootstrap.weights: uniform Dirichlet over syndicates, a syndicate's years sharing its weight
bayes_bootstrap.reading: a posterior over the exceedance rate under the bootstrap, not a test

honest.label: honest: 10-fold by syndicate, adopted model refitted on each fold's training syndicates
honest.note: fold assignment is oos_validation.fold_assignment; held-out syndicates are in neither the pool nor the fit

leave_out.pool: every row whose held-out unit differs from the target's

leave_out_and_target_year.pool: as leave_out, and without the rows of the target's own reporting year

honest_posterior_draws.operator_construction: size-only operator: gamma fixed at 0 in the likelihood (the headline fit); a refit, not a zeroing: k, sigma_undiv, sigma_div, nu_clean and nu_RITC are that fit's own posterior. sigma does not depend on H, so the concentration channel of any decomposition is exactly zero
honest_posterior_draws.label: honest, with parameter uncertainty: the operator's predictive VaR integrates over each fold fit's posterior draws
honest_posterior_draws.method: for each held-out target, the operator transfers the fold's pool under each of 600 posterior draws of the fold fit (evenly spaced through its chains), the transferred pools are mixed with equal weight, and VaR_alpha is the mixture's inverse CDF; the folds, pools, targets, bootstrap weights and splits are the honest version's

leave_out.pool: every row whose held-out unit differs from the target's

leave_out_and_target_year.pool: as leave_out, and without the rows of the target's own reporting year

cheap.label: cheap: leave-one-syndicate-out reusing the full-sample posterior means
cheap.note: the pool is honest; the scale law and tail indices were fitted WITH the held-out syndicate in the sample

leave_out.pool: every row whose held-out unit differs from the target's

leave_out_and_target_year.pool: as leave_out, and without the rows of the target's own reporting year
